watch.en: Brown the surface of the food first.
watch.de: Zuerst die Oberfläche des Garguts bräunen.

why.en: Browning the surface adds flavour, and searing first gives a dark crust and a caramelised taste.
why.de: Das Bräunen der Oberfläche bringt Geschmack, und zuerst scharf anzubraten gibt eine dunkle Kruste und einen karamellisierten Geschmack.

sources.title: Culinary Foundations (Cheramie and Thibodeaux)
sources.sentence: is first pan-seared to brown its surface and enhance its flavor (through the Maillard reaction).

sources.title: Culinary Foundations (Cheramie and Thibodeaux)
sources.sentence: Searing and then turning down to low is also beneficial when a dark crust and caramelized flavor is desired for the finished product.
